metadata.title: Pass 3 hemodynamic coupling reference: lumenized Poiseuille plexus perfusion, Pries wall-shear structural adaptation, flow-stealing pruning and Notch-gated arteriovenous specification

provenance_legend.measured: numerical value taken from the cited publication (figure/table/equation)
provenance_legend.derived: value computed from a cited closed-form law (e.g. Murray 1926, Pries 1995 set-point formula)
provenance_legend.approximate: order-of-magnitude or qualitative-direction value from the cited publication; the DIRECTION of the effect is the validated claim, the number is a band, not a point
provenance_legend.assumption: modelling choice of this script with no direct literature value; listed so the audit can see every free parameter

blood_viscosity_pa_s.note: apparent in-vivo viscosity scale used for the microvascular network simulations (Fahraeus-Lindqvist / hematocrit dependence NOT modelled: residual)

arteriolar_pressure_mmhg.note: terminal arteriole pressure in the rat mesentery network data (30-45 mmHg band)

venular_pressure_mmhg.note: post-capillary venule pressure (20-30 mmHg band); the 15 mmHg arteriole->venule drop sets the capillary perfusion pressure

wss_set_point_formula.value: tau_e(P) = 100 - 86 exp(-5000 (log10(log10 P))^5.4) dyn/cm^2, P in mmHg
wss_set_point_formula.note: pressure-dependent wall-shear set point, Pries, Secomb & Gaehtgens 1995 Eq. 2 / Pries et al. 1998 Eq. 3; 1 dyn/cm^2 = 0.1 Pa

metabolic_stimulus_form.note: Pries et al. 1998 Eq. 4; the negative feedback that stabilises a parallel bed against shear-only shunt collapse

capillary_min_radius_um.note: minimum luminal radius that still passes a deformed red cell (~2.6 um lumen diameter); segments below this are pruned

adaptation_gain.note: log-sensing structural adaptation rate; sets the time scale only

shrinkage_bias.note: constant shrinking tendency k_s of Pries et al. 1998 Eq. 6; numerical value is a calibration

metabolic_gain.note: k_m; calibrated so WT bed neither collapses to a single shunt nor fails to prune

av_identity_gains.note: logistic gains on local pressure rank and log shear ratio for the ephrinB2/EphB4 readout; gated by Notch transduction

capillary_wall_shear_stress_pa.note: capillary / post-capillary wall shear stress band of in-vivo microvascular beds (10-20 dyn/cm^2); Pries 1995 Fig. 3 shows tau falling from arterioles (~4-6 Pa) through capillaries to venules (~1 Pa)

murray_bifurcation_exponent.note: cube law r_p^3 = sum r_d^3 at uniform wall shear (Lean Theorem 4); measured microvascular exponents cluster at 2.7-3.0

kirchhoff_node_residual_m3_s.note: exact mass conservation at every internal node of the resistor network (solver correctness check)

arteriovenous_marker_segregation_index.note: ephrinB2 (arterial) and EphB4 (venous) are mutually exclusive in the wild-type embryonic vasculature; index 1.0 = every arteriolar segment reads arterial and every venular segment reads venous

arteriovenous_segregation_notch_loss.note: Notch-deficient (mindbomb / dominant-negative Su(H)) zebrafish lose arterial ephrinB2 and gain venous markers in the dorsal aorta, with arteriovenous shunts: no segregation (chance level 0.5)

notch_blockade_perfused_density_ratio.note: Dll4 blockade (Dll4-Fc / DAPT) increases vascular density and branch-point count by roughly 1.3-2x in the neonatal retina while perfusion per vessel falls (Lobov 2007 Fig. 2-3; Hellstrom 2007 Fig. 1); the model reproduces hyperdensity as under-pruning of a uniform-calibre bed

flow_arrest_regression.note: segments with little or no flow regress and are pruned (zebrafish midbrain; chick yolk sac le Noble 2004); the no_flow control must prune at least as much as WT

shear_only_shunt_instability.note: shear-stress adaptation alone is unstable and collapses a parallel bed into one arteriovenous shunt; the metabolic stimulus restores stability (Pries 1998 Fig. 2-3)
